reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass: function is actively called at market.move:722 (Gate 1), no trust_assumptions table exists in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json to look up the liquidator entry point (Gate 2), and the affected file is explicitly in-scope with liquidation logic listed as a focus area (Gate 3). An attacker (whitelisted liquidation bot) can trigger this via the public liquidate entry point by repaying up to close_factor * total_debt (e.g. 50% of $1000 debt = $500) on a barely-unhealthy obligation (risk = 1.001 needing only ~$1 repayment), causing the borrower to lose significantly more collateral than a proper soft liquidation to risk==1.0 requires; the bad-debt bypass at L985-992 additionally permits unlimited repayment when collateral_value <= 1.01 * debt_value, compounding the severity.
